bio.text: Jose Vega is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for New York's 15th Congressional District on the Speak The Truth Party line, after losing the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia says he was born in New York City, attended Bronx Community College, has worked as a barista, and has been affiliated with the Schiller Institute and the LaRouche Organization.
He took part in an April 2026 virtual debate with Michael Blake hosted by OneNYC Action, which the Bronx Times described as featuring Vega, a political activist who identifies as a LaRouchite.

sources.title: Michael Blake and Jose Vega debate housing, immigration and Israel in NY-15 race
